title: OpenAI says Astra AI model is its first that crosses ‘Critical' cybersecurity capability
raw_excerpt: OpenAI says its upcoming model, Astra, is the first offering that crosses its 'Critical' cybersecurity capability threshold. The model can apparently find previously unknown security flaws and exploit them without step-by-step guidance from humans. OpenAI plans to make the model available soon, but will limit access to its cybersecurity capabilities. The company will share more details about its security and safety practices in the model's System Card at launch.
summary: OpenAI即将发布的Astra模型成为其首个跨越“严重”网络安全能力门槛的AI，能够自主发现并利用未知安全漏洞，无需人类逐步指导。OpenAI计划限制其网络安全功能的访问，并在发布时公布系统卡。这一进展引发安全担忧，研究人员警告Astra可能成为AI安全领域最糟糕的发展。

title: The Trump administration is supporting OpenAI in the NYT copyright lawsuit
raw_excerpt: The Trump administration has intervened in The New York Times' copyright lawsuit against OpenAI, making an argument in favor of the AI lab. The landmark lawsuit, filed in December 2023 , alleging that OpenAI unlawfully trained its AI systems on articles from The New York Times and seeks to recoup "billions of dollars" in damages from both Microsoft and OpenAI. This week, the Trump administration filed a statement of interest in the case, supporting OpenAI's argument that it's fair use to train an AI model on copyrighted text. title: Atlas: A World Model for Spatial Intelligence
raw_excerpt: Atlas is a world generation model pretrained from scratch to natively operate on text, images, video, and 3D. It combines all inputs into a shared spatial context and uses that context to generate what comes next. The model is built to scale, and its performance improves with increased training compute. Atlas can perform a broad range of tasks spanning world generation, reconstruction, and simulation. Video examples of what the model is capable of are available in the article.
summary: World Labs发布Atlas世界模型，这是一个从零开始预训练的世界生成模型，原生支持文本、图像、视频和3D，将多模态输入统一到共享空间上下文，用于生成后续内容。Atlas可执行世界生成、重建和模拟等任务，性能随训练计算量提升，为空间智能提供新范式。

title: Meta's Muse Voice Transcribe
raw_excerpt: Muse Voice Transcribe is Meta's first real-time audio perception model. It supports streaming speech recognition, diarization for more than 20 speakers, endpointing, multilingual code-switching, and contextual biasing.
summary: Meta发布Muse Voice Transcribe，这是Meta首个实时音频感知模型，支持流式语音识别、超过20人的说话人分离、端点检测、多语言代码切换和上下文偏置。该模型有望提升实时语音交互体验，推动音频AI应用发展。
